notes.title: 🔄 Localization Update! 🔧🌍
notes.content:
🚀 Attention, gamers! 

We've initiated crucial changes in the localization loading logic. 💼 This aims to fix startup issues some users may have encountered. 🛠️ Thanks for your patience and understanding! 🙌 Your feedback is invaluable, and we continue to refine the game together with you. 🎮
